name: pets-compliance
description: Pet program Stage P6 — pet profile + compliance checklist. In Pro mode we declare cat+dog, mesh only SOME windows (partial CMF status) and open the Pet compliance panel (#petCompliancePanel) → screenshot the partial statuses. Then mesh EVERY window + add a litter box → re-screenshot the improved statuses. Then enter a room editor + open the catalog on the pets tab with the declared pets' essentials surfaced first. Finally a mobile-viewport frame of the panel showing the 'Do you have pets?' chip selector + checklist.
